Files.Title: BIOS Update for Windows
Files.Description:
Description :
It is recommended to download and update the BIOS and firmware for system performance optimization. The update takes a few minutes, please do not turn off your computer during the process to avoid critical problem that system cannot be turned on.
Caution! Active updates are possible during the Windows Update process!

(UEFI is a firmware package that controls keyboard, monitor, disk and other hardware devices and provides software interface to help OS control hardware devices.)

Important Information:
Optimize system performance

Introduction :
- MyASUS in UEFI BIOS - Introduction

How to Install :
- How to update BIOS in Windows

FAQ :
- Troubleshooting - Laptop occurs black screen when the BIOS update process is interrupted
- The Firmware in Device Manager shows a yellow exclamation mark (yellow bang)

Files.Title: ROG MCU Firmware Update tool
Files.Description:
Description :
This app updated MCU firmware to fix MCU related issues. Please keep your device plugged to a power source and do not turn it off until the update process is completed.

Important Information :
Button Actions : Remap the Command Center and Action buttons to your preferred system functions. (Requires the latest ACSE)

Minimum OS Version :
Windows 11 64-bit 24H2

Files.Title: ROG MCU Firmware Update tool
Files.Description:
Description :
This app updated MCU firmware to fix MCU related issues. Please keep your device plugged to a power source and do not turn it off until the update process is completed.

Important Information :
1. Improved in-game grip vibrator feedback experience, (Need to wait for ACSE 4/E release)?
2. Fixed Ring LED not working issue after screen on/off, if enabled “ACSE>Performance>Keep machine running when the screen is off” option

Minimum OS Version :
Windows 11 64-bit 24H2
